review_mode: READ_ONLY_SOURCE_AND_RETAINED_DEV_EVIDENCE; no source edits, builds, cargo, native queries, qualification or reserved reads/runs
scope: Independent proof-integrity audit of the DEV native verifier only; no PR verdict, qualification, producer semantic certification, admission parity or R0 decision.

findings.title: Credited calls and source coordinates are checked on wire envelopes, while the returned graph uses unchecked payload fields
findings.status: STATIC_CONTROL_FLOW_FINDING; representative breaking witness specified, not executed in this read-only review

anchors.fact: graph_from_received_facts clones raw node/edge payloads into the consumer graph
function semantic tuple uses payload kind/path/name, but exact source coordinates are checked only on envelope range
calls projection filters fact_kind=edge:calls and checks payload from/to, but never payload.kind
facts, graph and synthetic freshness bindings are built after stdout from that same batch; graph digest equality cannot independently establish graph semantics
receiver checks hash bindings and envelope node ids/endpoints/ranges, without validating node payload ids or payload evidence against those envelopes
consumer graph uses payload node id, edge kind/from/to and EvidenceRef source lines
baseline graph emits symbol evidence lines and actual calls edges connecting graph node ids

breaking_witnesses_possible.mutation: On an actual successful native batch, retain edge fact_kind=edge:calls and endpoints, change only its payload.kind to related_to, then produce coherent facts_id/graph_id for the changed batch before verifier observation.
breaking_witnesses_possible.expected_required_result: Semantic oracle rejects the graph because the alias call is absent.
breaking_witnesses_possible.current_source_result: Call tuple remains the expected pair; envelope endpoint checks still pass, and the reconstructed graph has no calls edge. No existing assertion rejects this mutation.

breaking_witnesses_possible.mutation: Change or remove an incident function payload.id while preserving its envelope id and semantic kind/path/name; refresh producer facts/graph digests.
breaking_witnesses_possible.expected_required_result: Reject missing graph node identity or dangling graph endpoint.
breaking_witnesses_possible.current_source_result: Semantic identities use envelope ids; receiver endpoint closure uses envelope ids; graph payload contains a missing/different node id and can retain a dangling call.

breaking_witnesses_possible.mutation: Change or remove function payload.evidence source lines while keeping the envelope range correct; refresh producer facts/graph digests.
breaking_witnesses_possible.expected_required_result: Reject the incorrect source pointer in the assembled graph.
breaking_witnesses_possible.current_source_result: Only envelope range is compared with frozen coordinates; graph EvidenceRef is not checked. UTF16 fields are private envelope coordinates and are not asserted here as baseline Graph EvidenceRef fields.

findings.impact: The current evidence supports a narrow wire-envelope projection, but does not support the reported pipeline claim that independently checked reconstructed graph payloads contain the credited alias call and source coordinates. This is a proof gap in the verifier, not a demonstrated semantic defect in the producer.
findings.repair_direction: Use the already reconstructed consumer graph as the semantic oracle input, or explicitly validate the relevant payload kind/id/endpoint/source-line relation to the checked envelopes. Add a targeted actual-oracle negative witness on a changed copy of successful stdout, retain rejection and restored success, without changing frozen expectations.

assessment_by_surface.selection_and_empty_discovery: Two explicit test functions select fixed cases 0/1; hardcoded whole-fixture digest rejects an altered/empty fixture. Missing helper or SDK panics; no runtime opt-out observed.
assessment_by_surface.expected_to_producer_coupling: Expected function/call tuples, subject denominator/outcomes and refusal reason originate in frozen hand-authored cases. No producer semantic implementation was read by this reviewer. Identity primitives are shared only for transport hashing; graph-payload correctness remains the F1 gap.
assessment_by_surface.denominator: Expected subjects are taken from frozen source_bytes; exact outcomes from expected_subject_outcomes; receiver validates cardinality, expected ids, uniqueness and selections. No omitted-subject bypass found for these two cases.
assessment_by_surface.process_path: Verifier imports semctx_gates::process and calls run_with_helper directly. tools/qualification/src/process.rs was inspected only to establish the shared supervisor relationship; its wrapper is not the invocation path here. Actual retained Outcomes show native binary argv and pre/post stable producer/helper hashes.
assessment_by_surface.receipt_and_freshness: Receipt binds observed facts/graph and issuer; independent freshness/build/binding booleans are synthetic controlled receiver state. Existing capture-file and graph-change witnesses test metadata/binding rejection, not automatic public filesystem recapture or real freshness/ownership acquisition. Author report states this limit.
assessment_by_surface.semantics: Credited independent envelope projection is three named functions with ranges, exactly one imported alias call with parameter-homonym absence, and one controlled default-expression refusal. Other kinds are expressly uncredited.
assessment_by_surface.fail_closed: Observed malformed request => nonzero, 1ms budget => timeout, 1-byte cap => output_limit; receiver ProcessFailure assertions are on the native Outcomes, not fake process fixtures. Unexpected helper absence, JSON shape, terminal, outcome or subject count causes failure.
assessment_by_surface.fake_receipt_or_tamper_claim: No forged execution claim established. SHA before/after fields match in all inspected final Outcomes. Postcapture source is really written/read/restored but the receiver sees an explicitly rebuilt in-memory capture; that boundary is disclosed.
